preconditions.description: The length of the mask m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#_' for c in m)
preconditions.description: The mask m must only contain the characters '#' and '_'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(m[i] == '#' and m[i+1] == '#' for i in range(len(m)-1)) else True
postconditions.description: If there are consecutive filled cells in the mask, output -1.
If there are no filled cells in the mask, output 0.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == 2 and all(int(x) > 0 for x in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If a valid profile exists, output the number of integers in the profile followed by the profile integers.
